fonts.display: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: White
palette.role: Page canvas, base card surface, nav background

palette.name: Cream
palette.role: Warm off-white section background, soft card fill — the secondary surface layer that gives the page its paper-like warmth

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Elevated card surfaces and subtle section bands

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input underlines — the structural skeleton of the layout

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Tertiary text, placeholder copy, disabled states

palette.name: Steel
palette.role: Secondary body text, helper copy, muted descriptions

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Secondary body text on cream surfaces

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Secondary body text, navigation labels, and subdued headings. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Warm Gray
palette.role: SVG icon fills, subtle warm-toned decorative elements

palette.name: Espresso
palette.role: Primary text on cream surfaces, dark card accents, outlined action borders — the warm alternative to pure black

palette.name: Midnight
palette.role: Primary body and heading text on white, the dominant ink color

palette.name: Pure Black
palette.role: Primary headings, body text, and icon fills on light surfaces. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Deep Ink
palette.role: Footer and nav text, dark surface accents

palette.name: Slate Blue
palette.role: Muted blue-gray for section backgrounds, subdued text accents, and image overlay washes — adds cool depth without competing with the cobalt accent

palette.name: Warm Sand
palette.role: Warm tan card surfaces, trust/social-proof section backgrounds — a near-gray with just enough warmth to echo the photography

palette.name: Cobalt Spark
palette.role: Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Emerald
palette.role: Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color
